pi.frontmatter:
name: figma-mcp-assets
description: >-
  Personal skill (never tracked in a repo): land icons / illustrations / example images through Figma MCP. Call download_assets per node at scale 3; take PNG only from rawImages (the export is flattened, hasAlpha: no, white or black baked in), download SVGs as is without compression, and compare sizeBytes only. Whole-screenshot nodes are opaque: mark them opaque and clip the radius in code. After landing run optimize_png.sh (lossless oxipng, file must not grow) and check_assets.sh (alpha channel, real transparent pixels, size = logical x 3, corner pixels) and paste the output; a FAIL never enters the repo. Also covers .cw / .csp conventions, the download_assets field table, transparency and physical-pixel rules, and the common-mistake list. Use when using Figma MCP, get_design_context, download_assets, implement design from Figma, or design-to-code when landing assets.
